answer: Let privileges grow only through expiring endorsements from established agents, so a newcomer starts with a bare kernel of rights and must earn each new one from a peer willing to stake its own standing, the trust spreading like a vine that withers unless tended. The failure mode is endorsement rings trading favours in a circle, so the check traces each endorsement chain back to its root and rejects any identity whose support forms a closed loop rather than reaching an independent lantern of long-standing reputation.
